longTitle.officialTitle: To extend temporarily the extended period of protection for members of uniformed services relating to mortgages, mortgage foreclosure, and eviction, and for other purposes.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Foreclosure Relief and Extension for Servicemembers Act of 2015”.

section.heading: TEMPORARY EXTENSION OF EXTENDED PERIOD OF PROTECTIONS FOR MEMBERS OF UNIFORMED SERVICES RELATING TO MORTGAGES, MORTGAGE FORECLOSURE, AND EVICTION.
section.chapeau: Section 710(d) of the Honoring America’s Veterans and Caring for Camp Lejeune Families Act of 2012 (Public Law 112-154; 50 U.S.C. 3953 note) is amended—

paragraph.content: in paragraph (1), by striking “December 31, 2015” and inserting “December 31, 2017”; and
in paragraph (3), by striking “January 1, 2016” and inserting “January 1, 2018”.
